title: Set Matrix Zeroes
description: If a cell is 0, set its entire row and column to 0 in-place.

data.text: Given an `m x n` matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0 in-place.
Use two boolean arrays to record which rows and columns need zeroing. O(m·n) time, O(m+n) space.

data.title: Mark Arrays O(m·n)

data.text: Approach 2: First Row / Col as Markers
Use the first row and column themselves as the mark arrays. Track whether the first row/col originally had a zero. O(m·n) time, O(1) extra.

data.title: In-Place O(m·n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(m·n) both ways. **Space:** O(m+n) → O(1). The first row/column become your memory — just remember whether they themselves need zeroing.
